decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established finishing range in a growing market, and with no visible sign of underperformance, management would likely keep it while results continue to develop.

Because the UV spot varnishing system is more distant from the firm's core offer and so faces a higher aspiration-risk mismatch, it has the greatest drop risk, but the launch prominence and the firm's broad portfolio still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
This sheet preparation module builds directly on existing capabilities, so boundedly rational management would usually retain it unless clear evidence of disappointing sales appeared.
The B2-format multifinisher is close to the core business and was highlighted prominently at launch, which suggests expectations are being met well enough to avoid problemistic search.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's established postpress portfolio, and in the absence of any negative market signal the firm is likely to keep it under normal organisational slack.
This folding add-on has explicit evidence of customer adoption, so it most clearly meets aspiration levels and is the least likely to be removed from the market soon.
